text: It has created a backdoor amnesty program unrecognized in law, granting worker authorization to illegal aliens, and shown little regard for the lifeanddeath situations facing the men and women of the border patrol.
mention: the men and women of the border patrol
prev_texts:
It has lessened worksite enforcement - and even allows the illegal aliens it does uncover to walk down the street to the next employer
and challenged legitimate State efforts to keep communities safe, suing them for trying to enforce the law when the federal government refuses to do so.
next_texts:
Perhaps worst of all, the current Administration has failed to enforce the legal means for workers or employers who want to operate within the law.
In contrast, a Republican Administration and Congress will partner with local governments through cooperative enforcement agreements in Section 287g of the Immigration and Nationality Act to make communities safer for all and will consider, in light of both current needs and historic practice, the utility of a legal and reliable source of foreign labor where needed through a new guest worker program.
label: No

But the pandemic has also exacerbated existing inequalities.
next_texts:
Women carry a particular burden in the systemically relevant professions of care, education and retail, but are significantly less well paid and less represented in decision-making processes.

next_texts:
The family is the most important defense against the increasing fatigue in the industrial society and against the collectivization tendencies of socialist ideologies.
A policy that leaves the families left, lives at the expense of the future and sets the germ for future social conflicts.

Investment and innovation are the key to new jobs.
next_texts:

Jobs are created when capital is created, investment is made possible and therefore demand is created.

prev_texts:
Since the social law reform in 2005 (Hartz reform), the amount of the right to unemployment allowance II and, except for the minor stage, the reference period of unemployment allowance I are not taken into account when determining whether and, where applicable, how long the person concerned was previously employed under the obligation of social insurance.
After a regular period of 12 months, formerly long-term workers receive unemployment benefits II in the same amount and for the same period of time as unemployed persons who have never previously paid contributions to unemployment insurance.
next_texts:
The AfD therefore advocates for a stacked longer reference period of unemployment allowance I depending on the duration of pre-employment.
The self-restraint in the calculation of unemployment allowance II is to be increased without penalty.

Since the social law reform in 2005 (Hartz reform), the amount of the right to unemployment allowance II and, except for the minor stage, the reference period of unemployment allowance I are not taken into account when determining whether and, where applicable, how long the person concerned was previously employed under the obligation of social insurance.
After a regular period of 12 months, formerly long-term workers receive unemployment benefits II in the same amount and for the same period of time as unemployed persons who have never previously paid contributions to unemployment insurance.
next_texts:
The AfD therefore advocates for a stacked longer reference period of unemployment allowance I depending on the duration of pre-employment.
The self-restraint in the calculation of unemployment allowance II is to be increased without penalty.

text: Without such a restriction on the free movement of workers, Austria would have been affected by a massive immigration and professional donation migration due to the strong wage differences and, consequently, by a significant increase in the shortage of Pushcher, which would have led to a competition for displacement, i.e. a massive increase in the unemployment of domestic workers.
prev_texts:
The negotiated transitional periods of up to seven years in the area of free movement of persons have ensured that the existing restrictions on access to the labour market will continue after the enlargement.
Thus, there will not be an increase in labour-related immigration, nor will there be an uncontrolled increase in migratory activity in nearby border areas.
next_texts:
Without transitional periods in the area of freedom to provide services, there would have been disruptions in some sensitive sectors, such as the cleaning, construction or construction sectors.
The "service donation" of cleaning companies from neighbouring countries to the Austrian metropolitan areas and the problems arising due to wage and price differences has been effectively prevented by the introduction of transitional periods.

text: In a continuously technologically improving society, creative jobs last longer than others, and their share in both employment and the national economy is growing.
prev_texts:
For the best outcome, it is time to stop the rigid separation and focus on a common goal.
It is time to respect the Constitution, according to which the ultimate idea of the Estonian state is to create the best conditions for citizens to live a cultural, spiritually fulfilling life, but not to lead and organize the national "art production".
next_texts:
It is time to trust in the decision-making of the representatives of the cultural sector, who form the most creative, educated and thus better managed and independent decision-making part of society alongside the academic.
The greater the autonomy of this part of society, the freedom to decide within the limits of its field, the more satisfied the people, the better organized the environment.

It is time to respect the Constitution, according to which the ultimate idea of the Estonian state is to create the best conditions for citizens to live a cultural, spiritually fulfilling life, but not to lead and organize the national "art production".
next_texts:
It is time to trust in the decision-making of the representatives of the cultural sector, who form the most creative, educated and thus better managed and independent decision-making part of society alongside the academic.
The greater the autonomy of this part of society, the freedom to decide within the limits of its field, the more satisfied the people, the better organized the environment.

text: Those who are able to live independently should be helped by the community.
mention: Those who are able to live independently
prev_texts:
Developing homeless care and reducing homelessness on the street Homelessness is not a real home, the goal is not to crush homeless people in mass accommodation, but to have a home for all of us.
Homeless benefit should therefore be in line with the principle that only those who absolutely need it should live in long-term care institutions.
next_texts:
Thus, on the one hand, we respect the autonomy and dignity of those in need, and on the other hand, we ensure that everyone who absolutely needs institutional accommodation has access to appropriate care.
Among the above measures, the development of debt management services, the establishment of a private bankruptcy institution and the reduction of evictions will make a significant contribution to preventing homelessness.

The poor health of a large part of the Romanian population requires adequate screening, especially for those groups of diseases in which we can calculate their spread due to poor living conditions (e.g. pulmonary screening, dental screening, etc.).
The relevant groups should be informed in the important field of health education, and in the context of the educational concept, it is important to train appropriate Gypsies (prevention, family planning, lifestyle, basic hygiene skills, etc.)
next_texts:
The culture of the Romanians in Hungary has constantly appeared in cultural policy endeavors so far.
